notes:
Use Cases tab landing (CHR-1062). Data: `get_use_cases` (list + facets). Sample project: a large one (Pablo, product owner) to show the list at scale.

**Layout.** `uc-topbar` (fourth tab "Use Cases" active) · left panel 296px (sub-nav Use cases | Personas | Data objects, `+` = new use case) · main = detail of the selected use case (same markup as `usecases-detail`, clipped at 900px; the main column scrolls, content centred at max 960px).

**Left panel, top to bottom.**
- Search: title, trigger, goal, outcome and step actions (`query`). `/` focuses it.
- Filters as `uc-filter-chip`: Persona, Status, Tag, Screen (mapped screen), Has variants (toggle). An applied filter is `active` ("Persona: Pablo ×", × clears). Drawn: the Status menu open (`open` + `chrome-menu-item` rows) with **facet counts within the current filters** (Draft, Ready); Ready is checked. Status is the maturity of the spec only (ADR-010): Draft or Ready — no priority, no "Implemented".
- Result line "212 of 1,284 use cases" + sort control (Group A–Z · Title · Status · Recently changed).
- Tree grouped by `group` path segments (`mapping/elements` → mapping › elements). `uc-group-row` shows the matching count; rows are `uc-list-row` (title; meta line: status dot, status, variant count).

**Built for thousands.** Groups load collapsed except the path to the selected case; a group renders at most 4 rows, then "Show N more". Implement as a virtualized flat list of visible rows; group counts come from facets, not from loaded rows.

**Keyboard.** `role="tree"` / `treeitem` with `aria-expanded`; Up/Down move, Left/Right collapse/expand, Enter opens.

**Flows.** row → `usecases-detail`; + / Edit / + Variant → `usecases-edit-dialog`; Personas → `usecases-personas`; Data objects → `usecases-data-objects`; variant chip and the coverage hint → `usecases-detail-variant`; Show on screens / target chips → `usecases-mapping`.
